value.rationale: This is a sharp parameter boundary on a natural canonical family for an existing weighted approximation problem. The finite-weight crossing optimizer reverses the familiar inscribed behavior and certifiably beats both whole nested classes without requiring a global optimizer classification. Strict Dowker convexity through the branch switch and sharp order asymptotics add exact, useful information beyond a single example.
